scientific_limitations: One-dimensional nearest-neighbor iid site fields, independent geometric global regeneration p>=3/4, annealed variance. The leading crossover does not decide the exact critical line; the explicit fourth-order bound is conservative. General analyticity and the first two Taylor coefficients follow from the cited source; the cubic centered case and uniform crossover are the assessed contribution.
title: Universal cubic diffusivity crossover under rapid environment regeneration
